GardenCenterGuide page re-read: all seven days show 'unknown', no rating, and the 'just getting started with online reviews' line is present; 44 Fern Rd and 732-254-9348 confirmed. results.name: Jordan Psychotherapy Group
results.notes: Every claim I checked held. Live site: LocalBusiness JSON-LD present but minimal (name + image only); an h1 element exists with no text; zero a[href^=tel:] links; zero forms; contact email is jordanpsychotherapygroup@gmail.com; no hours/fees/insurance text on the homepage or on /contact-us, which lists the two clinicians' direct numbers as plain text plus 688A Nassau Street. At 390px emulation the document renders 1034px wide in a 390px viewport with text clipped on both sides - matches the broken-mobile issue. /robots.txt allows all crawlers and blocks PetalBot, as recorded. Google place page re-opened: 3.2 from 9 reviews and a live 'Claim this business' prompt (note its hours read 'Open, closes 9 PM', so hours exist on Google even though the site has none). Homepage confirms Belle Mead, telehealth and the 20+/30+ year experience lines. Scores (gap 5, ability 2, ease 4, evidence 4) are reasonable for a two-clinician practice.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: I opened https://www.state.nj.us/mvc/pdf/license/drs.pdf and searched the extracted text: there is no 'Accelr8' entry and no match for 'Accel' anywhere in it. The only North Brunswick school on that roster is 'Montgomery Driving School LLC, 1014 Livingston Avenue - Suite 207, North Brunswick NJ 08902'. wrong_claims.what_is_true: Both cited pages blocked me (YellowPages served a Cloudflare block page, GetPassed stayed on a 'Just a moment...' bot check), so neither the 732-940-0008 number nor the 'online booking unavailable' line could be re-verified this pass.

A separate directory (bestprosintown.com) carries the business with review text and the same all-day 'Open 24 hours' hours, so it does operate. The problem is the evidence chain: the MVC roster claim is false and two of the four directory sources were unreachable, which leaves the discounted Google profile plus one aggregator. Evidence dropped 3 -> 2; gap 5, ability 3 and ease 4 stand.
